crmarenapro-1.evidence: Query: WITH v AS (SELECT Id AS x FROM core_crm.Account UNION ALL SELECT AccountId FROM core_crm.Contact) SELECT count(x) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE starts_with(x,'#')) prefixed FROM v; returned 253 prefixed of 987 (25.6%), bearing out about 25% in these ID fields.

crmarenapro-2.evidence: Query: WITH v AS (SELECT Name AS x FROM core_crm.Account UNION ALL SELECT Email FROM core_crm.Contact) SELECT count(x) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(x)>length(rtrim(x))) trailing FROM v; returned 205 of 987 (20.8%), bearing out about 20% in these text fields.

crmarenapro-3.evidence: Query: WITH v(f,x) AS (SELECT 'Id',Id FROM core_crm.Account UNION ALL SELECT 'AccountId',AccountId FROM core_crm.Contact UNION ALL SELECT 'ContactId',ContactId FROM sales_pipeline.Opportunity UNION ALL SELECT 'Name',Name FROM core_crm.Account UNION ALL SELECT 'FirstName',FirstName FROM core_crm.Contact UNION ALL SELECT 'LastName',LastName FROM core_crm.Contact UNION ALL SELECT 'Email',Email FROM core_crm.Contact UNION ALL SELECT 'Subject',Subject FROM activities.Task UNION ALL SELECT 'Status',Status FROM sales_pipeline.Contract) SELECT f,count(*) FILTER (WHERE starts_with(x,'#') OR length(x)>length(rtrim(x))) affected FROM v GROUP BY f; returned nonzero affected counts for all nine fields (Id 29, AccountId 224, ContactId 302, Name 16, FirstName 187, LastName 203, Email 189, Subject 1015, Status 40), bearing out the item.

crmarenapro-2.evidence: I compared values with rtrim(value): trailing whitespace shows up in 15.8% of Account.Name, 21.3% of Contact.Email, 22.2% of Event.Subject, 24.5% of Contract.Status and 19.7% of Lead.FirstName. That fits roughly 20%.

It returned 10,761 clinical rows, 10,761 with a barcode in Patient_description, and 10,467 matching molecular participant barcodes, supporting this way to match records (not universal coverage).

PANCANCER_ATLAS-3.evidence: Query: SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(Patient_description, '(?i)uuid')) AS mentions_uuid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(Patient_description, 'TCGA-[A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+')) AS mentions_barcode, count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(Patient_description, '(?i)(female|male)')) AS mentions_gender, count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(Patient_description, '(?i)(vital status|alive|dead)')) AS mentions_vital_status FROM clinical_database.clinical_info. It returned total 10,761; uuid 6,748; barcode 10,761; gender 10,761; vital status 10,761, supporting that the descriptions hold such details, though UUID is not mentioned in every row.
